evidence_summaries: CAM_FRONT shows the white taxi (654) crossing left in front of ego, with two pedestrians standing directly in the crosswalk just beyond it, clearly poised to continue across the ego path. CAM_FRONT_LEFT shows the same taxi only at its right edge and no pedestrians in ego's path.

CAM_FRONT shows a lone pedestrian in dark clothing standing on the roadway ahead near the left curb, apparently having stepped off the left parking row toward the lane; posture suggests crossing/completing a crossing in front of ego rather than walking along traffic. CAM_FRONT clearly holds the decisive evidence.

CAM_FRONT shows a UPS truck stopped in the right portion of the road ahead with cones and construction narrowing the right side, supporting a leftward shift. CAM_FRONT_RIGHT shows a parked Boston Bean van and construction barriers off to the right side, also consistent with obstruction but less clearly in the ego path.

CAM_FRONT shows an open intersection with crosswalks, no truck ahead and no traffic signal for ego; a white SUV sits at the right edge near the right-hand approach. CAM_FRONT_RIGHT shows that white SUV, slightly blurred, entering the roadway near the stop-sign-controlled right arm, supporting answer C.

Ego stopped at crosswalk of a stop-controlled intersection. A white SUV sits at the right edge of CAM_FRONT and appears larger, on the roadway with apparent motion, at the left edge of CAM_FRONT_RIGHT (STOP sign, Black Falcon Ave). No vehicle behind (CAM_BACK empty); left side is parking lot only.

CAM_FRONT shows the ego approaching a crosswalked intersection with vehicles clustered on the right side (white SUV at right edge, black SUV near the right corner), so it captures both the intersection and the right-arm vehicle. CAM_FRONT_RIGHT shows only the stop sign, median grass, and the same white SUV clipped at frame edge — weaker context. Ambiguity: the right-side vehicles look parked in a lot rather than occupying the ego's path, which slightly weakens option D.

CAM_FRONT shows a pedestrian at the right edge stepping onto the striped road area near the ego path; CAM_FRONT_RIGHT shows the same man clearly walking off the curb onto the roadway with a 'Pedestrians Use Crossing' sign, indicating an imminent crossing.

CAM_BACK_LEFT shows a man walking along the sidewalk toward a marked crosswalk at the curb ramp, facing the camera/ego. His path leads to the crosswalk, supporting crossing after ego passes; alternatively he may simply continue along the sidewalk.

CAM_FRONT shows a pedestrian on the right-hand crosswalk area walking toward the ego lane; a left turn would take him further into the roadway, creating an immediate crossing conflict. CAM_FRONT_RIGHT shows the same pedestrian mid-crossing on hatched markings, also supporting the conflict reasoning.

CAM_FRONT shows the whole intersection: pedestrians crossing at left and, on the right, people near cones/construction barrels and a work zone beside a dark SUV. CAM_FRONT_RIGHT is dominated by the occluding black SUV with only a distant worker, giving no clear intent cue; CAM_FRONT is the broadest evidence of continued crossing motion.

CAM_FRONT shows two-wheeled riders ahead near the left edge of the roadway, aligned with the ego travel direction, no lateral lean or turning cue toward the ego lane and no curb stop; other cameras show only buildings, a bus and cars, no cyclist.

CAM_FRONT_RIGHT shows a cluster of pedestrians gathered at the right-side corner beside the signalized crosswalk, some already stepping toward the striped crossing with a give-way sign and traffic signal overhead, consistent with waiting to cross once the ego passes.

CAM_BACK_LEFT clearly shows three pedestrians walking along the wide building-frontage walkway parallel to the road, well inside the plaza with planters/curb separating them from the roadway; no one faces or approaches the street, supporting continued walkway travel.

CAM_FRONT shows two pedestrians walking across the road ahead near the right-side junction mouth, with a parked truck beyond; they are the immediate yielding constraint. Removing them would leave a clear path to complete the right turn, supporting answer C with CAM_FRONT as decisive view.

A red Trans-Cab taxi is parked beside the kerb, fully visible in CAM_FRONT_RIGHT and clipped at CAM_FRONT's right edge. No signal or pedestrian exists. However the taxi sits on the ego's RIGHT, not left; the left side (CAM_FRONT_LEFT, CAM_BACK_LEFT) shows only trees, grass and sidewalk, creating a left/right mismatch with option A.
